text: Hi all, sorry if I am asking this repeatedly but I am still in the dark about applying for my citizenship and Piba wanting my home country (Germany) to officially ackonwledge my marriage. In our case, we went through the interview, Piba (MH overall) already registered us officially as married, but still, they delay my citizenship process until we have the documents. Can anyone advise here? My A5 is about to expire in October and Germany can take between 1 - 3 years (!!!) for everything. On the AIC website, it only says that the marriage registration in the home country is not necessary anymore for granting or renewal of B1/A5. So, for citizenship it WILL be mandatory?  Thanks 🙏❤️
